about_the_game:
Deadzone: Rogue features an original score crafted to immerse you in the rhythm of battle and exploration.

Experience a dynamic sci-fi OST that evolves as you progress through the ISS-X. From atmospheric tracks that build suspense to destructive combat themes that amplify each encounter, the Deadzone: Rogue OST draws you into the relentless rhythm of survival in deep space.

short_description: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite FPS set in space. Blast through hordes of enemies with devastating weapons. Define your combat style with powerful augments and upgrades. Grow stronger with each death, solo or in co-op. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.
